descriptionEn:
An apartment of 86.67 m² is offered for sale, located on Rruga Arberia, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Cima Construction.
Facing West, it has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, one bathroom, one storage room and one balcony.
It is located on the 4th floor.

The contract is signed at the notary directly with the construction company.
The works will be completed at the end of 2026.
The heating system is electric underfloor heating.
The apartment is located in a developed area, near public and private services.
